{{Current events|year=2019|month=06|day=24|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Amhara Region coup d'état attempt]]
**The Attorney General of [[Ethiopia]]'s [[Amhara Region]], Migbaru Kebede, dies after having been wounded during the coup attempt two days earlier. [[Asaminew Tsige]], the general suspected to be behind the coup attempt, had been reportedly killed by security forces. [https://www.dw.com/en/ethiopia-amhara-attorney-general-dies-after-coup-effort/a-49329224 (DW)]
*Men in camouflage kill 50 in [[Bahir Dar]], [[Ethiopia]] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-security-violence/more-than-50-killed-in-attacks-in-western-ethiopia-regional-official-idUSKCN1TR2FI (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two [[German Air Force]] [[Eurofighter Typhoon]] fighter jets collide in mid-air and crash near [[Müritz|Lake Müritz]] in [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]]. Both pilots are able to eject before the crash, but only one survives. [https://www.dw.com/en/two-eurofighters-collide-over-northern-germany/a-49332147 (DW)]

;International relations
*[[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] [[Michelle Bachelet]] says the tens of thousands of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] fighters and family members being held in [[Iraq]] and [[Syria]] must be tried or released, and calls on countries to take responsibility for their citizens and take them back if not charged. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48742972 (BBC)]
*[[Iran and state-sponsored terrorism]], [[Terrorism in Europe]]	
**The [[United Kingdom|British]] newspaper ''Independent in Arabic'' quotes an intelligence source as saying that in 2018 [[Iran]] had delivered half a ton of [[TATP]] explosives in diplomatic packages to a civilian plane that was supposed to be transferred to [[Paris]] to carry out an attack in the city. [https://www.jpost.com/Middle-East/Iran-attempted-attack-in-Paris-half-a-ton-of-explosives-found-report-593523 (The Jerusalem Post)]

;Law and crime
*Diane Madison, the mother of [[United States|American]] [[serial killer]] [[Michael Madison]], is stabbed to death in her home. Three children are also injured. Her grandson Jalen Plummer is arrested and charged with aggravated murder and felonious assault. [https://www.cleveland.com/metro/2019/06/man-charged-in-slaying-of-serial-killer-michael-madisons-mother-stabbing-of-three-sleeping-kids-in-cleveland.html (Cleveland.com)]

;Politics and elections
*The [[Ministry of Defense (Peru)|Defense Minister]] of Peru, [[José Huerta]], suddenly dies of cardiac arrest while worked. [https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2019/06/24/muere-el-ministro-de-defensa-de-peru-jose-huerta-torres/ (CNN en Español)] [https://peru21.pe/politica/murio-jose-huerta-ministro-defensa-fallecio-infarto-486285 (Perú 21)]

;Science and technology
*[[Methane on Mars]]
**[[NASA]] announces that its ''[[Curiosity (rover)|Curiosity]]'' rover has detected the largest ever measurement of [[methane]] on [[Mars]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-48743551 (BBC)]
*[[Soyuz MS-11]] returned to [[Earth]], landing in [[Kazakhstan]], from the [[International Space Station]] carrying [[Canada|Canadian]] [[David Saint-Jacques]], [[United States|American]] [[Anne McClain]] and [[Russia]]n [[Oleg Kononenko]]. The astronauts and cosmonaut spent 204 days aboard the ISS, a record for Canada. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/david-saint-jacques-1.5187999 (CBC)]

;Sports
*The [[2026 Winter Olympics]] are selected to be held in [[Milan]] and [[Cortina d'Ampezzo]], Italy. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/winter-olympics/48748380 (BBC)]
